base.description: The cable organizer as Vertiv sells VRA1001, four rings fitted.

datasheet.title: Vertiv VR Rack selection guide, SL-11367 (cable management, page 7; accessory table, pages 16 and 17)

description: 2U horizontal cable organizer with metal D rings, Vertiv VRA1001: a flat black plate the full width of the rack with four metal D rings that stand out of it and three oval openings between them. The rings hold bundles running along the plate. Sized, drawn and spaced from the maker's selection guide alone, which gives no dimension, so every figure of the drawing is an estimate.

gaps.note: the selection guide states no dimension of the part: the plate, the rings, the openings and the ear holes are scaled off one picture of of 194 x 117 px.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing or a data sheet of the VRA1001

gaps.note: the selection guide states no weight.
the selection guide states no cable capacity, no fill and no cable count.
gaps.wanted: a cable capacity table, or a stated fill, for the D-ring organizer

gaps.note: the picture shows each hook hanging below the plate's lower edge, by about a third of the plate's height scaled off the picture; the face of a part is bounded by its rack units, so the ring is drawn inside the plate's height and the part below it is not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned side view of the ring

gaps.note: the picture shows each ring as a rod bent to a hook with an open end; the format has no slit, and no page says how wide the opening is, so the loop is drawn closed.
gaps.wanted: a close view or a section of a ring

body.description: the flat plate, its ears and its three oval openings

guides.description: four metal D rings, cables passing along the plate through each

name: vra1001

attrs.note: datasheet - the colour (black) and the use ("cable routing panels with D rings", "in the front or rear of your rack") are the guide's text. The guide says only that the D rings are "metal" (page 7) and names no material for the plate, so `material` is not stated.

capacity.note: no page states a cable capacity: the guide is silent, so none is stated and a gap says so.

chassis.note: estimated - 482.6 x 88.9 x 76.5. Width is the 19 in of the guide's text (EIA-310), height the EIA-310 unit pitch for "2U", depth the ring reach scaled off the render (75.0) and a 1.5 mm plate. The plate is the whole width of the rack, its two ends the ears, so the face is drawn whole (L43 stands down above 480 mm).

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". The picture is a render, so the shades are this library's render of a black plate, the rings a little lighter than the plate and the screw heads the grey the picture shows.

ears.note: estimated - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder: the ears are the flat ends of the plate, so the ear plane is the plate's back face and the rings stand 76.5 mm in front of it. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: estimated - the plate seen from the ring side: four rings end-on, 134.0 mm apart about the middle, and three oval openings midway between them, read off the guide's picture. All three openings show in the picture, partly behind the rings; they are drawn equal in length, where the picture's differ through perspective.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the rings stand in front of the plate and nothing stands behind it, so the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part.

guides.note: estimated - the four rings are the guides: each a component with a `ring` guide (see its contract), cables passing along the plate through each in turn.

left.note: estimated - the side view: the plate's edge and a ring's profile in front of it, a frame 80.9 high with a foot, two rods and a closed end. The right is the same turned round.

method.note: ESTIMATED FROM A SELECTION GUIDE. Vertiv's VR Rack selection guide, publication SL-11367 (Vertiv) (PDF page 7 for the part's picture and description, page 16 for its fit table) names the part "2U horizontal cable organizer 2U with metal D rings (Qty. 1)", "Color: Black", and "19 in rack mounted". It prints no dimension, no weight and no drawing. The only picture is a raster of 194 x 117 px, a render seen at an angle, so the plate, the rings and the openings are read off it against the 19 in width and are estimates; where the picture does not show a feature (the plate's edges, the ring's fixing) none is drawn.

passes.note: estimated - the three oval openings: a cable crosses through each from one side of the plate to the other. Their places and sizes are scaled off the picture. The guide states no limit on the cable that fits.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the plate: the four ear slots and the three openings. The picture does not show the back; it is the front's holes seen from behind, with no feature added.

thickness.note: estimated - no page states a gauge. 1.5 mm is taken for the plate and 5.0 mm for the ring rod.

top.note: estimated - an elevation, rear at the top of the drawing: the plate's edge and the four rings from above, each 10 mm across and standing 75 out of the plate's front face. The bottom is the same from underneath. The picture shows no edge fold, so none is drawn.
